approved_rate_policy.stage_index: Active part N is one-based; counter zero is not Part 1.
approved_rate_policy.later_parts: Offset clamps to 15 for Part 18 and later.
approved_rate_policy.movement_unit: One admitted enemy move advances horizontal FB by +/-1 byte (2 packed pixels) or vertical FB by +/-320 bytes (2 scanlines at 160 bytes/line); four substeps advance one 8-pixel cell.
approved_rate_policy.oracle: For N logical callbacks from phase zero with C fractional carries, admissions = C + floor((N-C)/2); displacement = N+C pixels within one pixel at the phase endpoint.
approved_rate_policy.preserved_policy: Keep Part 9's 1.0 reset, B2 maximum two logical ticks with excess debt discarded, existing CoCo 300-logical-tick freeze duration, death bypass, and all player/pose/AI/route/type-group behavior. No per-actor debt or generic cap.

R10_AD1_keyboard_reference_map_symbols.qualification: Exact symbols parsed from the frozen corrected R10 AD1 keyboard maps. Addresses are reference anchors only; dispatch must recapture baseline and candidate maps after BUG-086 integration.

Candidate displacement is within 1 pixel of the approved rate-policy oracle for the same callback count, apart from the defined phase endpoint.
